name: Śrī Yantra
description: The Śrī Yantra as a system of 11 equations in 16 unknowns, scrambled and re-solved live with Newton's method.
aria: The Sri Yantra drawn in light, with its triple intersection points solved live
intro: Nine triangles must interlock so that, again and again, three lines pass through one point. Drawing it by hand is famously hard. Here it's an optimisation problem, solved in front of you.
